messages.content:
Risk: AI pursuing own goals
Description: The AI system may act in conflict with ethical standards or human goals or values, especially those of its designers or users, potentially using dangerous capabilities such as manipulation, deception, or situational awareness to seek power, self-proliferate, or achieve other misaligned goals.
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000246: obsolete: behavior AE — a behavioral AE that results in uncharacteristic behaviors [found by 8/14 queries]
  Siblings: obsolete: reflexes decreased AE, thrombocythemia AE - OBSOLETE (due to duplication), obsolete: medical device adverse event
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0004801: automatism AE — This is an AE which refers to a set of brief unconscious behaviors. [found by 6/14 queries]
  Siblings: somnambulism AE, attention-seeking behaviour AE, somatoform disorder AE
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 10/14 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 9/14 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/Authorization: authorisation — situation in which a party authorizes someone to act on their behalf or to have specific capabilities under certain conditions for some period of time [found by 9/14 queries]
  Siblings: trade, ownership control situation, study
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizingParty: authorising party — party that delegates some role, authority, or control to another party [from restriction: hasAuthorizingParty on Authorization]
  Siblings: owner, registrar, controlling party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizedParty: authorised party — party that has been given the ability to act on behalf of another party or to have specified capabilities under some set of guidelines for some period of time [from restriction: hasAuthorizedParty on Authorization]
  Siblings: Occupation Role, Contractor Role, service provider

axes.rationale: The risk centers on an AI acting autonomously and potentially in conflict with human goals. The 'software agent' class captures this notion of an entity with its own goals and the ability to act upon them.
The AI's actions might be characterized as 'automatisms' -  uncharacteristic behaviors that arise from its internal processes, potentially leading to unintended consequences.
